en.headline: Sun Dong departs for World Internet Conference in Wuzhen
en.dek: The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry left for Zhejiang on Monday afternoon to attend the summit, where he will speak at forums on AI agents and cross-strait internet development.
body: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong departed for Wuzhen, Zhejiang, on Monday afternoon to attend the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit, the government said.

The summit, hosted by the World Internet Conference and organised by the Zhejiang government, carries the theme “Open Source and Openness, Joint Contribution and Shared Benefits – Jointly Building a Community with a Shared Future in Cyberspace”. Sun will attend the opening ceremony and ministerial meeting, and deliver opening remarks at a forum on mutual trust and interoperability of AI agents as well as the Cross-Strait, Hong Kong and Macao Internet Development Forum.
Acting Commissioner for Digital Policy Daniel Cheung will also attend. Sun is due back on Wednesday evening. Under Secretary Lillian Cheong will act as Secretary during his absence.
The announcement was issued by the Information Services Department at noon on Monday.

zh.headline: 孫東啟程赴烏鎮出席世界互聯網大會峰會
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長周一下午出發前往浙江，將出席峰會並在智能體及兩岸港澳互聯網發展論壇致辭。
body: 政府表示，創新科技及工業局局長孫東周一下午啟程前往浙江烏鎮，出席2026年世界互聯網大會烏鎮峰會。
峰會由世界互聯網大會主辦、浙江省人民政府承辦，主題為「開源開放 共建共享——攜手構建網絡空間命運共同體」。孫東將出席開幕式及部長級會議，並在「智能體互信互聯互操作全球合作創新」論壇及「海峽兩岸暨港澳互聯網發展」論壇上作開幕致辭。
署理數字政策專員張宜偉亦會出席。孫東預計周三晚上返港，期間由創新科技及工業局副局長張曼莉署任。
有關公告由新聞處於周正午發出。
